title: SalesAssist Security Policy
introduction: At SalesAssist, protecting your data and ensuring the security of our platform are top priorities. We are committed to maintaining the highest standards of security and compliance to safeguard our customers’ information.

data.title: Data Protection and Encryption
text: Data in Transit: All data transmitted between users and our servers is encrypted using industry-standard TLS (Transport Layer Security).
Data at Rest: Customer data stored on our servers is encrypted using AES-256 encryption.
Authentication: We support secure authentication practices, including strong password requirements and multi-factor authentication (MFA) for account access.

data.title: Platform and Infrastructure Security
text: Cloud Infrastructure: SalesAssist is hosted on leading cloud providers with robust physical and network security controls.
Access Controls: Access to customer data is restricted to authorized personnel only, following the principle of least privilege (PoLP).
Monitoring and Logging: We maintain real-time monitoring of our systems and keep detailed audit logs to detect and respond to any unauthorized access attempts.

data.title: Application Security
text: Secure Development Practices: Our engineering team follows secure coding guidelines and best practices, including regular code reviews and vulnerability testing.
Regular Security Testing: We perform internal penetration tests and vulnerability scans regularly to identify and fix potential issues proactively.
Third-party Integrations: All integrations with CRMs and other systems are performed through secure APIs with strict access controls and auditability.

data.title: Incident Response
text: Rapid Response: In the event of a security incident, our dedicated security team is prepared to respond immediately.
Notification: If a data breach affecting your data occurs, you will be notified promptly in compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

data.title: Compliance
text: Data Privacy: We comply with applicable data protection regulations, including CCPA, GDPR, and other relevant standards.
User Control: You have full control over your data and can request access, correction, or deletion at any time.

data.title: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery
text: Backup Strategy: Regular encrypted backups of critical data are performed to ensure quick recovery.
Disaster Recovery: We maintain disaster recovery plans to ensure service continuity in the event of major incidents.
